news.titleEn: Trump rejects proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iran says it is awaiting definitive US position
news.conclusionEn: Trump on Saturday called Iran's seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and restart talks "unacceptable"; Tehran says it awaits a formal US reply via mediators.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普拒绝伊朗「七天重开霍尔木兹海峡」方案，伊朗称等待美方正式答复
news.whyEn: Hormuz remains effectively closed, keeping oil above $100 and inflation pressure high worldwide; a diplomatic breakthrough now looks further away.
news.whyZh: 海峡持续封闭令油价维持百元上方，全球通胀压力难消，和谈前景更渺茫
news.detailEn: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Iran had sent a concrete seven-day plan through Qatar, largely mirroring the June memorandum of understanding that collapsed last month: sanctions relief, release of frozen assets and a halt to military operations including in Lebanon. Trump said Iran wants the strait open immediately "because they're losing so badly" and that the deal would not be acceptable. The Hill reports he is weighing renewed strikes after the midterms. Oil markets will price the rejection when trading reopens Monday.
news.detailZh: 伊朗外长阿拉格齐称已通过卡塔尔向美方递交「具体七天计划」，内容与上月破裂的6月谅解备忘录基本一致：解除制裁、解冻资产、停止包括黎巴嫩在内的军事行动。特朗普称伊朗「输得很惨」才急于开放海峡，该方案不可接受。据报道他正考虑中期选举后恢复打击。周一开盘后油市将对这一消息作出反应。

news.titleEn: China, U.S. agree to $30 billion tariff cut, AI dialogue during Xi visit, Beijing says
news.conclusionEn: Beijing said Xi's Washington visit produced an eight-point consensus including a $30 billion reciprocal tariff cut, a new trade council and a US-China dialogue on AI.
news.conclusionZh: 中方称习近平访美达成八点共识，含300亿美元互降关税和AI对话机制
news.whyEn: It eases the world's most important trade relationship at a time of high inflation and yields, benefiting exporters, farmers and global supply chains.
news.whyZh: 中美贸易关系缓和，利好出口商、农产品和全球供应链，缓解通胀压力
news.detailEn: The Chinese Foreign Ministry said both sides will set up a trade council and extend the outcomes of earlier Kuala Lumpur talks, after Treasury Secretary Bessent said the trade truce would be extended by two months beyond Nov. 10. On AI, they agreed to a dialogue on risks and benefits, with the next round in November, plus a channel for AI-related incidents. The leaders also agreed Iran should not develop nuclear weapons and that no country should impose tolls on international waterways. USTR Greer has said further details will be released Monday.
news.detailZh: 中国外交部表示，双方将成立贸易理事会并延续吉隆坡会谈成果；此前美财长贝森特已宣布原定11月10日到期的贸易休战延长两个月。AI方面，双方同意就技术风险与收益开展对话（下一轮在11月），并建立AI事件沟通渠道。双方还同意伊朗应履行不发展核武器的承诺、任何国家不得对国际水道收取通行费。美贸易代表格里尔称周一将公布更多细节。

news.titleEn: The 10-year Treasury yield is at its highest in nearly two decades. How we got here
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.23% on Friday, its highest since 2007, driven by sticky inflation, rate-hike bets and heavy debt issuance by the government and AI giants.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10年期国债收益率升至5.23%，创2007年以来新高
news.whyEn: Higher long-term rates raise mortgage and corporate borrowing costs worldwide and pressure stock valuations, especially tech.
news.whyZh: 长期利率走高推升全球房贷和企业融资成本，压制股票尤其是科技股估值
news.detailEn: The yield was just below 4.8% earlier this month. Fed funds futures now price a 64% chance of an October hike, and Michigan survey year-ahead inflation expectations jumped to 4.6%. Macquarie's Thierry Wizman argues bond supply matters more than inflation: Washington is financing big deficits while Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle issued about $132 billion of debt through July to fund AI build-outs. More supply competing for buyers means yields could stay elevated.
news.detailZh: 本月初该收益率还略低于4.8%。联邦基金期货显示10月加息概率达64%，密歇根大学调查的一年期通胀预期升至4.6%。麦格理策略师认为债券供给比通胀更关键：美国政府为巨额赤字融资，同时谷歌、亚马逊、Meta、微软和甲骨文截至7月已发债约1320亿美元用于AI基建。供给大增意味着收益率可能持续高位。

news.titleEn: Australia Home Auction Clearances Hit 10-Week Low as Rate Hike Looms
news.conclusionEn: Australia's weekend auction clearance rate fell to a 10-week low of about 50% as markets price a near-certain RBA rate hike on Tuesday, Sept. 29.
news.conclusionZh: 澳洲房产拍卖清空率跌至10周低点，周二央行加息几成定局
news.whyEn: A hike to 4.60% would lift repayments for millions of Australian borrowers and cool the property market further.
news.whyZh: 若加息至4.60%，数百万澳洲房贷户月供上升，楼市将进一步降温
news.detailEn: Bloomberg reports 1,428 homes went to auction across capital cities, down 22.4% week on week, with a weighted clearance rate of 50.3%, partly due to a Melbourne long weekend. Markets price roughly a 90%+ probability that the RBA lifts the cash rate by 25 basis points from 4.35% on Tuesday, and all major banks now forecast a hike, as trimmed-mean inflation remains stuck around 3.6%. August CPI data follows on Wednesday and will shape expectations for November.
news.detailZh: 彭博报道，上周各首府城市共1428套房产上拍，环比减少22.4%，加权清空率为50.3%，部分受墨尔本长周末影响。市场定价澳储行周二将现金利率从4.35%上调25个基点的概率超过九成，各大银行均预测加息，原因是截尾均值通胀停滞在3.6%左右。周三将公布8月CPI，将影响11月议息预期。

news.titleEn: US Hiring Appetite Is Healthy as Economy Powers Ahead
news.conclusionEn: Economists expect Friday's US September jobs report to show about 90,000 new payrolls with unemployment holding at a one-year low of 4.1%.
news.conclusionZh: 预计本周五美国9月非农新增约9万人，失业率维持4.1%
news.whyEn: Another solid print would strengthen the case for a Fed rate hike in October and could push yields even higher.
news.whyZh: 若就业继续强劲，美联储10月加息理由更充分，收益率或进一步上行
news.detailEn: Hiring in August rose by the most since March, and economists see momentum continuing despite mounting cost pressures. Last month's upside surprise sent the 2-year yield to its highest since early 2025 and fueled hike bets. With the 10-year yield already above 5.2%, the report is this week's key macro event for global markets.
news.detailZh: 8月新增就业为3月以来最多，经济学家认为尽管成本压力上升，就业动能仍在延续。上月数据大超预期曾推动2年期收益率创2025年初以来新高、加息预期升温。在10年期收益率已超5.2%的背景下，这份报告是本周全球市场最关键的宏观事件。

news.titleEn: Trump says he is rolling back Biden-era US fuel economy rules for cars
news.conclusionEn: Trump announced new US fuel economy standards, to be released Monday, that roll back Biden-era rules and end what he calls the "EV mandate".
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普宣布放宽拜登时代汽车油耗标准，终结「电动车强制令」
news.whyEn: It reshapes product and investment plans for automakers like GM and Ford, and weakens the US push toward electric vehicles.
news.whyZh: 将改变车企产品与投资规划，削弱美国电动车转型动力
news.detailEn: If the final rule mirrors last year's proposal, the 2031 model-year requirement would drop to about 34.5 mpg from roughly 50 mpg. The administration says it will cut the average new-car price by around $930 and boost US manufacturing. NHTSA's own estimates showed the rollback could raise fuel consumption by about 100 billion gallons through 2050 — notable with oil above $100 due to the Iran war.
news.detailZh: 若终版规则与去年草案一致，2031车型年油耗要求将从约50英里/加仑降至34.5英里/加仑。政府称此举可使新车均价降低约930美元并促进本土制造。但美国公路交通安全管理局此前估算，到2050年燃油消耗将增加约1000亿加仑——在伊朗战争令油价超百美元的背景下尤为引人关注。

news.titleEn: China's Consumer Stocks Face Lost Decade as AI Steals Spotlight
news.conclusionEn: MSCI China consumer goods sub-indexes have fallen about 18% in six months to near 10-year lows, while the AI-heavy tech gauge has more than doubled from 2016 levels.
news.conclusionZh: 中国消费股半年跌约18%近十年低位，AI科技股却大幅跑赢
news.whyEn: It shows how Beijing's AI-first policy focus and weak household spending are splitting China's market, a key signal for global investors and consumer brands.
news.whyZh: 反映中国政策押注AI、居民消费疲弱，市场严重分化，影响全球投资者与消费品牌
news.detailEn: During the latest earnings season, consumer staples firms in the MSCI gauge missed profit forecasts by nearly 50%. Capital has flowed toward AI and hardware names favored by policymakers, leaving consumer companies starved of investor attention. A sustained recovery likely requires stronger stimulus aimed at household income and confidence.
news.detailZh: 最新财报季中，MSCI指数内必需消费品公司利润较预期低了近50%。资金持续流向政策扶持的AI与硬件板块，消费类公司被投资者冷落。消费股要真正回暖，可能需要更多针对居民收入和信心的刺激政策。

news.titleEn: Burnham to Outline Vision for Britain's Economy at Labour Conference
news.conclusionEn: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will use Tuesday's Labour conference keynote in Liverpool to lay out his plan to lift Britain out of low growth and political turbulence.
news.conclusionZh: 英国首相伯纳姆将在工党大会发表主旨演讲，阐述经济振兴方案
news.whyEn: With UK borrowing costs elevated and a budget due next month, gilt investors will watch closely for signals on fiscal discipline.
news.whyZh: 英国融资成本高企、下月将出预算，债市高度关注其财政纪律信号
news.detailEn: Burnham, who has pledged radical change, acknowledged public finances are "challenging" and said delivering fiscal stability is crucial before tackling bigger problems. Global shocks including the Iran conflict have fueled UK inflation and pushed up borrowing costs, leaving little room for manoeuvre. Any hint of looser spending could unsettle the bond market.
news.detailZh: 承诺「激进变革」的伯纳姆承认公共财政「充满挑战」，称必须先实现财政稳定才能解决更大问题。伊朗冲突等全球冲击推高了英国通胀和借贷成本，政策空间有限。若释放放松财政的信号，可能引发英债市场波动。

news.titleEn: Powerful nor'easter causes coastal flooding and knocks out power to parts of the Northeast
news.conclusionEn: A slow-moving nor'easter battered the US Northeast coast on Saturday with high winds, flooding and power outages affecting about 100,000 customers.
news.conclusionZh: 强力东北风暴袭击美国东北沿海，约10万户停电
news.whyEn: Tens of millions of people in the densely populated New York–New England corridor face disruption to travel, business and insurance losses.
news.whyZh: 纽约至新英格兰人口密集区数千万人受影响，交通、商业和保险损失值得关注
news.detailEn: The National Weather Service warned of high winds, high tides and heavy rain over the next few days, with the highest tides north of Atlantic City from Saturday night into Sunday. New York Gov. Kathy Hochul warned anyone near the water was "gambling with their life." Coastal flooding hit Long Island and New Jersey shore towns, and the storm is expected to linger through the weekend.
news.detailZh: 美国国家气象局预警未来几天将有强风、高潮位和暴雨，大西洋城以北地区周六夜间至周日潮位最高。纽约州长霍楚尔警告靠近水边「等于拿生命冒险」。长岛和新泽西沿海城镇已出现海水倒灌，风暴预计将持续整个周末。

businessTips.explanationEn: Jobs to Be Done is a framework that says customers don't buy products — they "hire" them to get a specific job done in their lives. Instead of segmenting by age or income, you ask what progress the customer is trying to make and what they would otherwise use. This reveals your real competitors and the features that actually matter. It helps teams avoid building things nobody needs.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「用户任务」理论认为，顾客不是在买产品，而是「雇用」产品来完成生活中的某项任务。与其按年龄收入划分用户，不如问：他们想取得什么进展？不用你的话会用什么替代？这能揭示真正的竞争对手和真正重要的功能，避免做出没人需要的东西。
businessTips.exampleEn: A famous study found many morning milkshake buyers "hired" it to make a boring commute less dull and keep them full until lunch — competing with bagels and bananas, not other milkshakes. Making it thicker and faster to buy boosted sales more than new flavors.
businessTips.exampleZh: 经典案例：很多早上买奶昔的人，是「雇用」它来打发无聊通勤、撑到午饭，它的对手是贝果和香蕉而不是别家奶昔。把奶昔做得更稠、购买更快，比推新口味更能提升销量。

businessTips.explanationEn: Niching down means deliberately narrowing your target customer or problem so specifically that you become the obvious choice for that group. A narrow niche makes marketing cheaper, word-of-mouth stronger and premium pricing easier to justify. For side hustles with little budget, being "the best for a few" beats being "okay for everyone." You can always expand once you dominate the first niche.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「细分定位」指刻意把目标客户或问题收窄到非常具体，让自己成为这群人的不二之选。细分市场营销成本更低、口碑传播更快，也更容易收取溢价。对预算有限的副业来说，「对少数人最好」胜过「对所有人还行」。拿下第一个细分市场后再扩张也不迟。
businessTips.exampleEn: Instead of "cleaning service," offer "Airbnb turnover cleaning for hosts in one suburb" with photo checklists and same-day reporting. Hosts searching for exactly that will find you first and pay more for reliability.
businessTips.exampleZh: 与其做「保洁服务」，不如做「某区Airbnb房东专属换房清洁」，附带拍照清单和当日报告。正在找这类服务的房东会第一时间找到你，并愿意为可靠性多付钱。

businessTips.explanationEn: Earnings yield is the inverse of the P/E ratio (earnings ÷ price); it shows how much profit you "get" per dollar of stock. Comparing it with the risk-free government bond yield tells you how much extra return stocks offer for their extra risk. When bond yields rise sharply, stocks look relatively less attractive unless earnings grow. It's a quick sanity check on market valuation.
businessTips.explanationZh: 盈利收益率是市盈率的倒数（每股收益÷股价），代表每花1美元买股票能「获得」多少利润。把它与无风险国债收益率对比，就能看出股票为承担额外风险多提供了多少回报。当国债收益率大涨时，除非企业盈利同步增长，股票的相对吸引力就会下降，这是判断市场估值的快速检验法。
businessTips.exampleEn: If the S&P 500 trades at 22 times earnings, its earnings yield is about 4.5%. With the 10-year Treasury at 5.23% this week, investors can earn more from a "risk-free" bond than from stock earnings — one reason rising yields weigh on equities.
businessTips.exampleZh: 若标普500市盈率为22倍，盈利收益率约4.5%。而本周10年期美债收益率已达5.23%，意味着「无风险」债券回报高于股票盈利收益率——这正是收益率上升压制股市的原因之一。
